tianxia.subpath.qi.samsara_wheel_cultiva.why: Choose three Former-Life Mantles (free buttons, kept until changed); the first known one is active at the start of the fight; "Turn the Memory" (Bonus Action, 1 Qi) switches to another known Mantle and gives its Arrival; the active Mantle's Speed, Opportunity-Attack Disadvantage, once-per-turn weapon damage and free step, difficult-terrain and Charmed-save rules run, the rest is said as a GM line (combat/ext/mantles.py).
